overall_goal: Heat a pan on the stove and add olive oil to it

goals.description: Set up the pan on the stove and turn on the heat
goals.rationale: The person places the pan on the stove, turns on the burner, and sets the pan back down to begin heating.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon and measure olive oil into the pan
goals.rationale: The person opens a drawer to get a spoon, then opens the olive oil bottle and uses the spoon to pour oil into the heating pan.
